traditions.WLC: וּ בְנֵ֖י עֻלָּ֑א אָרַ֥ח וְ חַנִּיאֵ֖ל וְ רִצְיָֽא
traditions.LXX: καὶ υἱοὶ Ὠλά · Ὀρέχ , Ἁνειὴλ καὶ Ῥασειά .
traditions.VUL: Fílii autem Olla : Arée , et Hániel , et Résia .
traditions.KJV: And the sons of Ulla ; Arah , and Haniel , and Rezia .

40.english_reference: All these [ were ] the children of Asher , heads of [ their ] father ’s house ,

traditions.WLC: כָּל אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי אָ֠שֵׁר רָאשֵׁ֨י בֵית הָ אָב֤וֹת
traditions.LXX: πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἀσήρ , πάντες ἄρχοντες πατριῶν
traditions.VUL: Omnes hi fílii Aser , príncipes cognatiónum ,
traditions.KJV: All these [ were ] the children of Asher , heads of [ their ] father ’s house ,

40.english_reference: choice [ and ] mighty men of valour , chief of the princes .

traditions.WLC: בְּרוּרִים֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י חֲיָלִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֖י הַ נְּשִׂיאִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: ἐκλεκτοὶ ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει , ἄρχοντες ἡγούμενοι ·
traditions.VUL: elécti atque fortíssimi duces ducum :
traditions.KJV: choice [ and ] mighty men of valour , chief of the princes .

40.english_reference: And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war [ and ] to battle [ was ] twenty and six thousand men .

traditions.WLC: וְ הִתְיַחְשָׂ֤ ם בַּ צָּבָא֙ בַּ מִּלְחָמָ֔ה מִסְפָּרָ֣ ם אֲנָשִׁ֔ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ שִׁשָּׁ֖ה אָֽלֶף
traditions.LXX: ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν εἰς παράταξιν τοῦ πολεμεῖν , ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν ἄνδρες εἴκοσι ἓξ χιλιάδες .
traditions.VUL: númerus autem eórum ætátis , quæ apta esset ad bellum , vigínti sex míllia
traditions.KJV: And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war [ and ] to battle [ was ] twenty and six thousand men .
